# hpe_morpheus_service_plan (Data Source)

Service Plans in HPE Morpheus Enterprise determine the memory, storage, and cores configuration during provisioning and reconfiguration of an Instance.



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_service_plan" "test" {
  id = 99
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_service_plan" "test" {
    name = "Example name"
    provision_type_code = "arm"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Morpheus ID of the Object being referenced
- `name` (String) The name of the Morpheus service plan
- `provision_type_code` (String) The provision type code of the Morpheus service plan

### Read-Only

- `add_volumes` (Boolean)
- `code` (String) The code of the Morpheus service plan
- `config_ranges` (Attributes) The min and max ranges that instances using this service plan must conform to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config_ranges))
- `cores_per_socket` (Number) Number of cores per CPU
- `custom_cores` (Boolean)
- `custom_cpu` (Boolean) Can be used to enable / disable customizable cpu
- `custom_max_memory` (Boolean)
- `custom_max_storage` (Boolean)
- `description` (String) The description of the Morpheus service plan
- `max_cores` (Number) Max number of total cores
- `max_cpu` (Number) Max CPUs
- `max_disks` (Number) Max disks allowed
- `max_memory` (Number) Max memory size in bytes
- `max_storage` (Number) Max storage size in bytes
- `memory_size_type` (String)
- `price_set_ids` (Set of Number)
- `sort_order` (Number) Sort order
- `storage_size_type` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--config_ranges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config_ranges`

Read-Only:

- `max_cores` (Number) Custom max cores
- `max_cores_per_socket` (Number) Custom max cores allowed per socket
- `max_memory` (Number) Custom max memory in bytes
- `max_per_disk_size` (Number) Custom max per disk size in GB
- `max_sockets` (Number) Custom max sockets
- `max_storage` (Number) Custom max storage in GB
- `min_cores` (Number) Custom min cores
- `min_cores_per_socket` (Number) Custom min cores allowed per socket
- `min_memory` (Number) Custom min memory in bytes
- `min_per_disk_size` (Number) Custom min per disk size in GB
- `min_sockets` (Number) Custom min sockets
- `min_storage` (Number) Custom min storage in GB
